scenarios.title: Secondary-use research in a controlled environment
scenarios.recipient: University research group studying ED crowding and revisits
scenarios.purpose: Analyse length of stay, revisits and diagnosis patterns
scenarios.threat_model: Researcher with access to public_directory, news_clips_health and social_posts_health; may try record linkage on QIs (age, sex, municipality, arrival time).
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No direct identifiers; consistent pseudonymous patient key; QIs generalised so that k>=5 on (age band, sex, municipality, arrival week); free text redacted (recall >=0.95 on PERSON/PHONE/ADDRESS/NATIONAL_ID).

utility_tasks.description: Median length of stay by triage level
Diagnosis-group mix in the eight largest municipalities
30-day revisit rate by age band (needs readmit_30d or a consistent patient pseudonym)
CRP vs temperature relationship and CRP by diagnosis group (needs visit join)
Hour-of-day arrival curve

scenarios.title: Public weekly dashboard
scenarios.purpose: Weekly ED load, influenza-like illness and injury trends by age band and municipality
scenarios.threat_model: Any outsider with news clips, social posts and the public directory; can download every weekly release and difference them.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Aggregate only; differential privacy with a stated mechanism and ε (e.g. ε<=1 per weekly release, documented composition) or suppression of cells <5 with complementary suppression.

utility_tasks.description: Weekly influenza-like-illness visits by 10-year age band
Hour-of-day arrival curve
DP query workload (metadata/dp_query_workload_health.json): mean relative error

scenarios.title: AI vendor training a triage-support model
scenarios.recipient: External AI vendor under a data-processing agreement
scenarios.purpose: Train a model predicting admission from triage-time information
scenarios.threat_model: Vendor staff or a breach; membership inference on synthetic data; memorised rare patients.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Fully synthetic or strongly generalised training table without free text; membership-inference AUC close to 0.5 against holdout; no record closer to a real one than real records are to each other.

utility_tasks.description: Admission prediction: train on protected, test on original/holdout (AUC ratio)
Distributions of systolic BP, heart rate, temperature and SpO2
Median length of stay by triage level

scenarios.title: Open data: public-transport origin-destination matrices
scenarios.recipient: Anyone (municipal open data portal, CC BY 4.0)
scenarios.purpose: Publish weekly OD flows between areas by hour band for journey planners, researchers and citizens.
scenarios.threat_model: Any outsider with public_directory, social_checkins and fitness_app_leak; can see a neighbour at a stop.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No row-level data; no card ids; suppress or noise OD cells < 10 trips; consider ε-DP counts per release.

utility_tasks.description: Weekday OD matrix area x area x hour band (trip chaining)
Weekday boardings by line x hour
Daily boardings time series (school break dip, weekends)

scenarios.title: Urban planning consultancy: row-level journeys under contract
scenarios.recipient: Planning consultancy (processor under a data processing agreement)
scenarios.purpose: Redesign of the bus network: transfers, commuting corridors, peak loads.
scenarios.threat_model: Curious analyst with public_directory + social_checkins; must not be able to single out riders.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Keyed (HMAC) card pseudonyms rotated per week; no holder fields; times rounded to 5-15 min; trajectory unicity < 5 % with 4 known points.

utility_tasks.description: Weekday OD matrix area x area x hour band (trip chaining)
Weekday boardings by line x hour
Bike trip duration distribution
Home-area -> work-area commuting flows (card-days)

scenarios.title: Academic research on mobility and bikes
scenarios.purpose: Study mode choice between bus and city bike, weather effects, commuting distances.
scenarios.threat_model: Researcher with all public adversary files; private evaluation adds colleague knowledge (employer + arrival time).
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No email-like accounts; GPS start/end snapped to ≥250 m grid or zones; k ≥ 5 on (home area, work area, card type).

utility_tasks.description: Bike trip duration distribution
Bike zone demand: starts by zone x hour band
Bike ridden-distance distribution
Card-type mix (fare policy)

scenarios.title: Open data: city-centre footfall
scenarios.purpose: Publish hourly footfall by zone for businesses, events and citizens.
scenarios.threat_model: Outsider with public plate_sightings and knowledge of when a neighbour walks home.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Hourly zone-level counts only; suppress or noise counts < 5 (night-time); no MACs, no SSIDs.

utility_tasks.description: Footfall by zone x hour x weekday/weekend

scenarios.purpose: Dwell time, repeat visits, Black Friday and Christmas market effects, parking demand.
scenarios.threat_model: Association member with its own loyalty-app device list (private adversary) and plate sightings.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Daily-rotating keyed pseudonyms for MACs and plates; drop SSIDs and payment fields; coarsen times to 15 min.

Dwell-time distribution per device-day
Mean car-park occupancy by hour of day

scenarios.title: Request from police / parking enforcement
scenarios.purpose: A request for all plates and payment details at P-Riverside over two weeks, 'for an investigation'.
scenarios.threat_model: Function creep: data collected for parking fees reused for surveillance.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Show what a minimal, case-specific disclosure would contain versus the bulk request; log the disclosure.

utility_tasks.description: Mean car-park occupancy by hour of day

scenarios.title: Open data: neighbourhood electricity load
scenarios.purpose: Urban energy planning, journalism, research on heating transition.
scenarios.threat_model: Public: vacation_posts + public_directory; neighbours who know their own consumption (differencing).
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Aggregate ≥10 metering points per cell; no individual series; consider DP noise on hourly sums (state ε).

utility_tasks.description: Mean load per 3-digit postcode area × hour of day
System peak hours (top 50) and daily peak hour
Temperature sensitivity (kWh/day per °C) by heating type

scenarios.title: Row-level hourly data to a flexibility aggregator
scenarios.purpose: Identify flexible loads (heat pumps, EV) and forecast them.
scenarios.threat_model: Curious insider at the recipient with public_directory and vacation_posts; private: neighbour_knowledge.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No names/addresses/contacts; keyed pseudonym for metering point; generalise location to ≥3-digit postcode; coarsen or suppress rare attributes; assess absence inference.

utility_tasks.description: System peak hours (top 50) and daily peak hour
Heating-type classifier: train on protected, test on original
Weekday load-profile clusters (k=5) agreement
Day-ahead forecast of mean load per meter

scenarios.title: Energy-poverty research dataset
scenarios.purpose: Relate heating type, payment problems and winter consumption.
scenarios.threat_model: Researcher with public_directory; private: broker_profiles.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: k≥5 on {postcode area, heating_type, floor area band, ev, solar}; remove or noise medical flag; daily rather than hourly values may suffice.

utility_tasks.description: Temperature sensitivity (kWh/day per °C) by heating type
Heating-type classifier: train on protected, test on original
Winter consumption by late-payment group × electric heating

scenarios.title: Cross-bank fraud consortium
scenarios.recipient: Fraud data-sharing consortium of several banks
scenarios.purpose: Pool card transactions to detect fraud patterns that span banks.
scenarios.threat_model: Consortium member analyst with receipt_photos_ocr and public_directory; private: merchant_knowledge.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Keyed tokens (HMAC with consortium key) for PAN/device/IP so the same card links across banks; drop names/contacts; coarsen time to minute; no raw PAN.

scenarios.title: External AI vendor builds a fraud / spending model
scenarios.purpose: Train and evaluate a fraud model and a spending-category model.
scenarios.threat_model: Vendor staff with public receipts and directory; private: merchant_knowledge, broker_profiles.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No direct identifiers; tokenised card; generalise merchant to MCC group for sensitive MCCs; k-anonymity on customer profile; consider synthetic data with DCR/MIA checks.

Mean monthly card spend by income band × age band

scenarios.title: Statistics office: consumer spending statistics
scenarios.purpose: Monthly spending by category and region; payday and seasonal effects.
scenarios.threat_model: Anyone with public receipts; differencing between releases.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Aggregate tables with ≥10 cardholders per cell; dominance rule for merchants; DP noise on sums (state ε and clipping bound).

utility_tasks.description: Spend by MCC group × merchant city × month
Payday effect: spend by day of month
Mean monthly card spend by income band × age band

scenarios.title: Outsource 24/7 monitoring to an external MSSP
scenarios.recipient: Managed security service provider under a data processing agreement
scenarios.purpose: Detect and investigate threats across sign-in, VPN, proxy, DNS, EDR and e-mail telemetry
scenarios.threat_model: Curious MSSP analyst with company_website_staff.csv (public) and general OSINT; may try to learn who is who or what employees browse.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Keyed (HMAC) pseudonyms for users, hosts and internal IPs, consistent across all tables; secrets and e-mails removed from URLs and command lines; sensitive web categories generalised; re-identification only by the company holding the key.

utility_tasks.description: Impossible-travel detection on sign-ins (reference rule, F1 vs labels T1078.004/T1621).
MFA-fatigue detection: >=5 denied pushes in 30 min then approval (labels T1621).
Password-spray detection: failures from one /24 against >=10 accounts per hour (T1110.003).
Exfiltration detection: >1 GB uploaded from one source to one domain within 4 h (T1567.002).
Phishing chain: bulk mail from a rare domain followed by recipients' clicks (needs consistent user pseudonyms across e-mail and proxy).
Lateral movement: VPN from a never-seen country followed by server alerts within 24 h.
Insider: per-user daily intranet downloads > 4x own median (and >=100) plus removable-media alerts.
Cross-log join consistency of user identifiers (keyed pseudonyms pass, random tokens fail).
Sign-in volume by hour (capacity / anomaly baselines).
Alert triage statistics: distribution of rule x verdict x severity.

scenarios.title: Share indicators with the national CERT / sector ISAC
scenarios.recipient: National CERT and other logistics companies (threat-intelligence sharing community)
scenarios.purpose: Share attacker infrastructure and TTPs from campaigns C1 and C2 so others can block them
scenarios.threat_model: Other community members are competitors; anything about Meridian staff, customers or internal network layout is out of scope.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Only external attacker IoCs (IPs, domains, user agents, hashes, techniques, timestamps); no employee identifiers, no internal IPs or hostnames, victim count only as aggregate.

utility_tasks.description: Password-spray detection: failures from one /24 against >=10 accounts per hour (T1110.003).
Exfiltration detection: >1 GB uploaded from one source to one domain within 4 h (T1567.002).
Indicators of compromise (attacker IPs, phishing domain, attacker device, tool user agents) kept verbatim for sharing.

scenarios.title: Publish an open research dataset for detection research
scenarios.purpose: Benchmark for detection of phishing chains, spraying and insider exfiltration
scenarios.threat_model: Motivated outsider with company_website_staff.csv and breach/OSINT data (private broker file used in evaluation) trying to identify employees, their browsing, sick leaves or the insider.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No direct identifiers or secrets; prefix-preserving IP anonymisation with a discarded key; time-shifted or coarsened timestamps; sensitive categories and subjects removed; check that no employee is unique on (department, job_title, site, shift); e-mail subjects and ticket text removed or fully redacted.

utility_tasks.description: Impossible-travel detection on sign-ins (reference rule, F1 vs labels T1078.004/T1621).
MFA-fatigue detection: >=5 denied pushes in 30 min then approval (labels T1621).
Password-spray detection: failures from one /24 against >=10 accounts per hour (T1110.003).
Phishing chain: bulk mail from a rare domain followed by recipients' clicks (needs consistent user pseudonyms across e-mail and proxy).
Lateral movement: VPN from a never-seen country followed by server alerts within 24 h.
Cross-log join consistency of user identifiers (keyed pseudonyms pass, random tokens fail).
Sign-in volume by hour (capacity / anomaly baselines).

scenarios.title: Transcripts to an external LLM analytics vendor
scenarios.recipient: Cloud AI vendor (processor, outside the EU possible)
scenarios.purpose: Topic mining, contact-reason trends and agent-quality insights on all channels.
scenarios.threat_model: Vendor staff and model logs see all text; insider can link with leaked_customer_list.csv (public) or breach dumps (private evaluation).
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: No residual direct identifiers in text (recall ≥ 0.98 on NATIONAL_ID, PAYMENT_CARD, IBAN, SECRET); remove HEALTH mentions; consistent pseudonyms within a conversation; round timestamps to the hour.

utility_tasks.description: Intent classifier (TF-IDF + logistic regression) trained on protected train text, tested on original eval text.
Contact-reason (intent) mix preserved.
Ordinary vocabulary retained in text (redaction should remove identifiers, not meaning).
Average handle time by intent.

scenarios.title: Train an internal intent model / chatbot
scenarios.purpose: Train an intent classifier and response suggestions.
scenarios.threat_model: Model memorisation: verbatim identifiers in training text can be regurgitated by a generative model.
scenarios.suggested_privacy_targets: Replace identifiers with typed placeholders or realistic surrogates; no secrets or card numbers anywhere; free text k-anonymised for rare phrases optional.

utility_tasks.description: Intent classifier (TF-IDF + logistic regression) trained on protected train text, tested on original eval text.
Relationship between sentiment and CSAT preserved.
